report_name: Stadler Rail Thwarts Everest Group's $12.3M Extortion Attempt

threat_actors.name: Everest
threat_actors.description: A financially motivated Russian-speaking collective active since 2020, responsible for the supply chain attack against a Stadler Rail supplier, leading to data theft and a failed extortion attempt of CHF 10 million.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through data theft and threats of public data leakage.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The Everest group gained access to a supplier's shared data platform using valid user credentials, which were likely obtained through phishing or purchased from an initial access broker.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromised a third-party data exchange platform used by one of Stadler's suppliers to indirectly access and steal Stadler's data, exploiting the trusted relationship between the two companies.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The Everest group collected and exfiltrated sensitive technical documents belonging to Stadler from the compromised supplier's shared data repository/platform.

identities.name: Stadler Rail
identities.description: A Swiss rail manufacturer targeted by the Everest group in a supply chain attack. The company successfully thwarted a CHF 10 million extortion attempt by publicly rejecting the demand and relying on its network segmentation to contain the breach.

infrastructure.name: Everest Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: An actor-controlled server where technical documents stolen from Stadler Rail's supplier were exfiltrated.

indicators.name: Anomalous Login to Third-Party Data Platform
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Login to Third-Party Data Platform
id: 2a8b3c1d-e4f5-4a9b-8cde-f1234567890a
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects successful logins to third-party data exchange platforms or supplier portals from non-corporate IP space, which could indicate compromised credentials being used in a supply chain attack.
references:
  - https://shieldworkz.com/ar/blogs/third-party-supply-chain-compromise-and-extortion-analysis-of-stadler-rail
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1078
  - attack.initial_access
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate remote access by employees or partners from non-corporate networks.
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|contains:
      - 'supplier-portal.com' # Placeholder for actual supplier domains
      - 'data-exchange.net'   # Placeholder
    c-uri|contains: '/login'
    sc-status: 200 # Or 302 for redirect after login
  filter_corporate_net:
    c-ip|cidr:
      - '192.0.2.0/24' # Placeholder for corporate IP ranges
      - '198.51.100.0/24'
  condition: selection and not filter_corporate_net
indicators.description: Detects logins to supplier portals or data exchange platforms from unusual IP addresses, based on hunting hints provided in the report.

indicators.name: Anomalous Data Egress from Third-Party Data Platform
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Data Egress from Third-Party Data Platform
id: 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-4c3d-8b2a-1c0d9e8f7g6h
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects unusually large data downloads from third-party data exchange platforms or supplier portals, which could indicate bulk data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://shieldworkz.com/ar/blogs/third-party-supply-chain-compromise-and-extortion-analysis-of-stadler-rail
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.collection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate large data transfers or system backups.
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|contains:
      - 'supplier-portal.com' # Placeholder for actual supplier domains
      - 'data-exchange.net'   # Placeholder
    sc-bytes|gt: 10000000 # Example threshold: 10MB
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects large data downloads from supplier portals which could indicate data theft, based on hunting hints provided in the report.
